After Dark Radio with Bryan Alvarez is back today with a very special guest, Robin Warder of the TRAIL WENT COLD podcast. Just passing his 500th episode, Robin is here to talk mysterious disappearances and unsolved crimes, updates on famous old-school crimes like the Tylenol murders, and tons more. A fun show as always so check it out~!
